Helping with an important interview and attending an important birthday dinner show effort and responsiveness to Drew's priorities, supporting A.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: The challenge facts establish meaningful and sustained interest, so they reduce confidence in B. However, B remains the best-supported primary interpretation because Casey twice declined to define the relationship without offering a timeline, generally favored short-notice or geographically convenient meetings, canceled two advance plans for other commitments, did not introduce Drew to close friends or family, and declined to plan for an event two months ahead. Taken together, C2-F4 through C2-F6 more directly indicate limited willingness to commit, while C2-F1 through C2-F3 show interest that can coexist with low-commitment involvement.
